topic: Buying new kids sports gear every season vs swaps and secondhand gear (Jerome vs Gilda)

scenes.narration: Kids outgrow sports gear in one season, but parents pay full price. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a tiny hockey skate and a giant price tag, comic burst banner reads ONE SEASON, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jerome and Gilda both have a ten year old starting hockey.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man jerome and woman gilda each beside a child in a hockey jersey, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jerome walks into the big box store and buys everything new.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man jerome at a sports store with a cart full of new skates, pads, a helmet, and a stick, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Skates, pads, helmet, stick, and bag total seven hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt listing SKATES, PADS, HELMET, STICK, BAG with a total reading SEVEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: By next fall the skates are two sizes too small.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a child trying to squeeze into tiny skates, a growth chart on the wall, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Four seasons in, he has spent twenty eight hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading TWENTY EIGHT HUNDRED, a pile of outgrown gear, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gilda finds the league gear swap and a secondhand sports shop.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gilda at a community gear swap table with racks of used pads and skates, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Used skates, pads, and a helmet with a fresh safety date cost one eighty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gilda holding used skates and a helmet with a sticker reading CERTIFIED, a receipt reads ONE EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each spring she sells last year's gear back into the swap.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gilda handing outgrown skates to another parent, receiving cash, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Four seasons, her net cost is five hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a scoreboard reading FIVE HUNDRED NET, woman gilda and her child high fiving, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same rink, same kid, Jerome paid twenty three hundred more.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man jerome beside a mountain of new gear, woman gilda beside a small tidy bag, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Swap the gear. Kids grow, prices should not. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading SWAP THE GEAR, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
